# QuickLauncher

## What is QuickLauncher

QuickLauncher is a windows developer tool launch portal, it supports,

<!-- more -->

1. Configure the commands as launch item
2. Add existing application
3. Auto detect Microsoft Office App
4. Auto detect Jetbrains App
5. Set auto start for any command or App
6. Make emphasis for the developer health
    1. Allow to set a break reminder to notify developer to break for health for a period of time
    2. Allow to pause the reminder for meeting activity

## How to Download and Install

1. go to [https://github.com/zhaojunlucky/QuickLauncher/releases](https://github.com/zhaojunlucky/QuickLauncher/releases) to download the latest version
2. unzip it and launch quicklauncher installer.
3. run it after the install

## How to use it

1. Home

    ![1home.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-1home-c1c1d588-83b9-4132-aeb5-4501862e24a1.png)

2. Right click to open context Menu

    ![2contextmenu.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-2contextmenu-d24b75c6-99f0-4d0c-9262-c38715ff628e.png)

3. Click the "New Quick Command" menu to add a command

    ![3newcommand.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-08-3newcommand-8a6f7670-aeff-4dfc-bcce-7c993aa17540.png)

4. Create a new command from template

    ![3newcommandfromtemplate.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-08-3newcommandfromtemplate-d65b39d9-246f-4718-8f36-14412a706f79.png)

5. Create a command by selecting an app

    ![3newcommandselectapp.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-3newcommandselectapp-daa2aee4-3895-455a-8361-035b7248add2.png)

6. Settings

    ![4setting.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-4setting-7be8c4ea-0528-4649-9154-f99608748a53.png)

7. Enable Auto start quicklauncher allow the app to start afte the windows login on

    After enabled this, you can enable auto start for each app per your

8. Set a global Hot Key
9. Enable Detect Known Software will detect Office and Jetbrains
10. Enable Standup Reminder will notify by interval

    1. Break reminder

        ![5breakreminder.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-5breakreminder-53bdbd4c-64d8-44b8-97e7-ed3c6843889c.png)

    2. Pause reminder if you are in the focus work

        ![5pausereminder.png](https://writer.exia.app/api/v1/storage/b9a26b3989cd716a5758af8d164caab5/2025-07-5pausereminder-839c6766-29fe-4aa0-830d-65d7a6e5f2cd.png)
